The Sledzieski Lab at UC San Diego develops computational methods to better understand molecular structures and interactions, from modeling complex structural dynamics to building whole-organism interaction networks.

Our research Our team

Research

Learning the language of life

We train, investigate, and adapt large foundation models for biomolecular modeling.

Modeling dynamic allostery

We model the link between structural heterogeneity and molecular function through the lens of allostery.

Predicting molecular interactions

We build models for rapid and accurate prediction of protein-protein interaction networks.

Investigating function in diverse organisms

We develop high-throughput, robust, and generalizable models to study cellular systems across the tree of life.
